subject: Proposal: Senior IC consolidation + sensitive comms plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: jenna@orgconsult.com
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Senior IC consolidation + sensitive comms plan

Hi team —

I want to share a proposal to consolidate a handful of senior IC roles across Runtime and Serving (summary attached). This is a targeted reduction of overlap across three related scopes (kernel optimizer, runtime scheduling, and batch orchestration). High level:

- Scope: ~4 senior IC roles (level 5/6) where responsibilities materially overlap and velocity is being impacted by cross-team duplication.
- Goal: Reduce overlap while preserving critical ownership for latency-sensitive work and on-call continuity.
- Net headcount delta: -2 FTE (see headcount_impact_v2.xlsx).
- Timeline: aim for formal comms & manager 1:1s beginning week of Oct 12; notifications to affected individuals week of Oct 19.

Sensitive points that need input from HR & Legal: separation terms, severance baseline, manager talking points, and a privacy-safe list for outplacement vendors. Mina — I attached a draft comms doc and a role-mapping PDF with proposed redlines. Please treat this as confidential for now.

Asks:
1) Mina: initial redlines on the comms wording + proposed severance range and any mandatory notice considerations.
2) Markus: feedback on the mapping and operational risk (areas we cannot lose ownership).
3) Aditya: exec alignment / approval approach — do we run this through the next ELT or ask for an expedited sign-off?
4) Jenna (cc): ballpark availability & turnaround on outplacement packages and 1:1 coaching.

I included a short fallback plan in the comms draft that keeps critical oncall and preemptible capacity intact while we run a redeploy/backfill window.

Thanks — I know this is sensitive. I want to move thoughtfully and fast.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: headcount_impact_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), comms-draft-sensitive-roles.md (markdown), role-mapping-redlines.pdf (annotated PDF)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Senior IC consolidation + sensitive comms plan

Marissa — thanks for the clear write-up and materials. Quick notes:

- I agree there is overlap; the mapping looks reasonable overall.
- Operational risk: the kernel optimizer ownership is single-threaded right now — we need to ensure a named owner remains at least through Q1 to avoid regressions to tail latency. Suggest we carve out a retention/transition slot for that specific skillset.
- Backfill: if net -2 is the target, we'll want to prioritize hiring one early engineer with strong attention to perf to avoid a coverage gap.

If you want, I can sketch a short appendix with the minimal set of tasks that cannot be de-scoped and propose a 6-week transition playbook.

-Markus
Director, Serving Runtime

Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Senior IC consolidation + sensitive comms plan

Thanks for leading this, Marissa — succinct and thoughtful. A few items from ELT perspective:

- Exec timing: we can approve this off-cycle with a two-signer confirmation (me + CFO) if HR confirms standard severance & no outstanding legal flags. That will shave 7–10 days vs. waiting for the scheduled ELT.
- Compensation: recommend preparing an overlay showing final comp bands for any voluntary redeploy offers vs. separation packages; we want to be able to make a counteroffer where retention is critical.
- Message framing: emphasize protecting product continuity and minimizing individual disruption. Avoid technical detail in public comms.

Mina — if you can share the baseline severance ranges and the earliest statutory notice window, Aditya + I can confirm the off-cycle approval path. Also copy Legal if there are any unusual contract clauses (stock vesting acceleration, change-in-control language, etc.).

-Aditya
VP, Product & Strategy

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: legal-contracts@example.com
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Senior IC consolidation + sensitive comms plan

Marissa — I reviewed the comms draft and attached role mapping. High level comments:

1) Wording: tighten the "rationale" paragraph to remove process detail; we should focus on outcome and support options. I added inline edits in role-mapping-redlines.pdf.
2) Severance: recommend a baseline of 8 weeks pay + prorated equity handling (standard Redwood baseline) with enhanced packages for tenure >4 years. We should include an explicit offer of 3 months of outplacement support (Jenna/our vendor).
3) Legal: I copied External Counsel for a quick check on any stock/vesting clauses; they asked for anonymized employee IDs rather than names for an early review.
4) Comm cadence: my recommended approach — managers do 1:1s (not group), HR to provide manager scripts and offer outline, then a consolidated FAQ doc 24 hours after individual conversations.

From a privacy perspective, please provide a redacted list (employee IDs, role, manager, tenure, suggested outcome) — do not share names in the early legal review. Use the secure Drive folder only.

Also, Jenna — please confirm outplacement packages (coaching + resume support) and an estimate for turnaround if we have notices the week of Oct 19.

-Mina
Head of People Ops
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Thanks, everyone — clear and helpful guidance. Action items and owners:  

1) Mina: produce anonymized redacted list + final comms wording edits by 10/7 EOD; confirm severance baseline and copy Legal. (Owner: Mina)
2) Markus: please draft the 6-week transition playbook appendix and mark "non-degradable" task list by 10/8. (Owner: Markus)
3) Aditya: I'll prepare the comp overlay & run the off-cycle approval template with Finance; target to have sign-off ready by 10/9. (Owner: Marissa/Aditya)
4) Jenna: confirm outplacement capacity & per-person estimate by 10/8. (Owner: Jenna)

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for Tues 10/6 10:00am PT to walk through the plan and any legal flags. For now, please keep this thread strictly confidential.

—Marissa
Head of Product Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.com
